description: This Java interface defines a repository for managing BatchBusinessStep entities within a Spring Data JPA context. It extends JpaRepository and JpaSpecificationExecutor, providing methods to query and manipulate batch business step data, such as finding by job name, retrieving distinct job names, and deleting by job name.

classes.name: BatchBusinessStepRepository
classes.description: Spring Data JPA repository interface for BatchBusinessStep entities, providing CRUD operations and custom queries for batch processing.

methods.name: findAllByJobName
methods.description: Retrieves all BatchBusinessStep entities with the specified job name.

methods.name: findConfiguredJobNames
methods.description: Fetches a list of distinct job names configured in BatchBusinessStep records.

methods.name: deleteAllByJobName
methods.description: Deletes all BatchBusinessStep entities with the specified job name.
